final: WITH rt AS (SELECT p.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.rental_id, i.store_id), sa AS (SELECT store_id, AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM rt GROUP BY store_id) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.total) AS sum_totals, AVG(rt.total - sa.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM rt JOIN sa ON sa.store_id = rt.store_id WHERE rt.total > sa.avg_total GROUP BY rt.store_id
